tagline.en: The Bronx to Canada by Thruway and Northway
tagline.zh: 自布朗克斯经收费高速与北路直抵加拿大

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-278 in the Bronx, New York City
start.zh: 纽约市布朗克斯，与 I-278 相接

end.en: The Canadian border at Champlain, New York, continuing as Autoroute 15
end.zh: 纽约州尚普兰的加拿大边境，接魁北克 15 号高速公路

en: I-87 is three roads under one number. At the southern end it is the Major Deegan Expressway, a tight urban freeway along the Harlem River in the Bronx. From the city line to Albany it is the tolled New York State Thruway, crossing the Hudson on the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge and running up the river's west bank. North of Albany it becomes the Adirondack Northway, a toll-free road through the Adirondack Park to the Canadian border.

The change in character is abrupt. The Thruway section is a commuter and freight artery serving the densest part of the state; the Northway spends most of its length inside a six-million-acre park, with long gaps between exits and forest on both sides.
It is the main land route between New York City and Montreal, and it has been since its last section opened. At Champlain it becomes Quebec's Autoroute 15 and runs on to the Saint Lawrence.
zh: I-87 是三条路共用一个编号。南端是梅杰·迪根快速路，沿布朗克斯的哈莱姆河而行，是一条局促的城市高速。自市界至奥尔巴尼，它是收费的纽约州收费高速，经马里奥·M·科莫州长大桥跨越哈德逊河，沿西岸北上。奥尔巴尼以北，它成为免费的阿迪朗达克北路，穿过阿迪朗达克公园直抵加拿大边境。
性格的转变十分突兀。收费高速段是服务全州最稠密地区的通勤与货运干线；北路则大部分里程位于一座六百万英亩的公园之内，出口间距很长，两侧皆是森林。
自最后一段通车以来，它一直是纽约市与蒙特利尔之间的主要陆路通道。在尚普兰，它变为魁北克 15 号高速公路，继续通往圣劳伦斯河。

en: I-87 was assigned in 1957, but its southern two-thirds already existed or were being built as something else. The Deegan predates the Interstate system; the Thruway opened in stages from 1954, and the original Tappan Zee Bridge opened in December 1955, virtually completing the Buffalo-to-Bronx mainline. Early plans would have taken I-87 up the east side of the Hudson and through south-western Connecticut; that alignment was dropped in 1970 and the number was put on the Thruway instead.

The Northway was the part actually built as an Interstate. Work began at Albany in 1957 and the road opened piece by piece from October 1959. Governor Rockefeller wanted it finished in time for the 1967 World Exhibition in Montreal, and it was: the last thirty miles, between Underwood and Keeseville, opened on 31 August 1967 when a road crew rolled the barriers away without a ceremony.

It was the first long-distance toll-free Interstate completed in New York State. Earlier that year Parade had named a twenty-three-mile stretch between Lake George and Pottersville the best-designed new highway of 1966.
zh: I-87 于 1957 年定名，但其南段三分之二当时已经存在，或正以别的名义修建。迪根快速路早于州际公路系统；收费高速自 1954 年起分段通车，原塔潘齐大桥于 1955 年 12 月通车，使布法罗至布朗克斯的主线几近贯通。最初的方案原本要让 I-87 沿哈德逊河东岸北上、并穿过康涅狄格州西南角；该线位于 1970 年放弃，编号改挂在收费高速上。
北路才是真正按州际公路标准修建的部分。工程 1957 年自奥尔巴尼开工，自 1959 年 10 月起逐段通车。洛克菲勒州长希望赶在 1967 年蒙特利尔世界博览会之前完工，结果如愿：安德伍德与基兹维尔之间的最后三十英里于 1967 年 8 月 31 日通车——施工班组把路障推开，没有举行仪式。
它是纽约州第一条建成的长距离免费州际公路。同年早些时候，《Parade》杂志把乔治湖与波特斯维尔之间长二十三英里的一段评为 1966 年设计最佳的新建公路。

en: The Hudson crossing at Tarrytown has been rebuilt once. The original Tappan Zee Bridge, opened in 1955, was designed for a fraction of the traffic it ended up carrying and sat on one of the widest and deepest parts of the river. Its replacement, the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge, was built alongside it as twin cable-stayed spans, with the old structure demolished afterwards.

The new crossing is about three miles long and carries eight general traffic lanes across two decks, plus emergency shoulders, a dedicated bus lane, a shared-use path and reserved space for future commuter rail. Eight tapered towers lean outward from the deck. The approach grade was cut from three percent to one and a half, so that loaded trucks hold their speed on the climb.
The westbound and northbound span opened in August 2017; the eastbound and southbound span followed in September 2018, delayed a few days when a piece of the old bridge came loose during demolition.
zh: 塔里敦处的哈德逊河跨越工程已重建过一次。1955 年通车的原塔潘齐大桥，设计承载量远低于其最终实际承担的交通量，且位于该河最宽最深的河段之一。替代它的马里奥·M·科莫州长大桥在其旁侧新建，为两幅并列的斜拉桥，旧桥随后拆除。
新桥全长约三英里，两幅桥面共设八条常规行车道，另有应急路肩、一条公交专用道、一条人车共用步道，并为未来的通勤铁路预留了空间。八座锥形桥塔自桥面向外倾斜。引桥纵坡由百分之三降至百分之一点五，使重载卡车爬坡时能够保持车速。
西行与北行方向的一幅于 2017 年 8 月通车；东行与南行方向的一幅于 2018 年 9 月跟进，因拆除旧桥时有构件松脱而推迟了数日。

label.zh: 阿迪朗达克北路建设成本

value.en: $208 million for 176 miles from Albany to the Canadian border, built 1957–1967, with federal funds covering 90 percent; the road carries no tolls
value.zh: 自奥尔巴尼至加拿大边境 176 英里，造价 2.08 亿美元，1957 至 1967 年建成，联邦资金承担 90%；该路不设收费

figures.source: The New York Times, 29 August 1967; FHWA Highway History, 'By Day: August 30', 1967 entry

label.en: Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge, budgeted cost
label.zh: 马里奥·M·科莫州长大桥预算造价

value.en: $3.98 billion, the largest project in the history of the New York State Thruway Authority
value.zh: 39.8 亿美元，为纽约州收费高速管理局史上最大工程

figures.source: New York State Department of Transportation press release, 27 July 2017

label.en: Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge, full project accounting
label.zh: 马里奥·M·科莫州长大桥全项目核算

value.en: $4.979 billion including $3.142 billion for the design-build contract, $956 million in financing costs, $686 million in contingency and allowances and $62 million in prior development costs
value.zh: 49.79 亿美元，其中设计施工总承包合同 31.42 亿美元、融资成本 9.56 亿美元、不可预见费与备用金 6.86 亿美元、前期开发费用 6,200 万美元

figures.source: FHWA Center for Innovative Finance Support, Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge project profile

value.en: 333.65 miles in New York. The route log's I-87 entry also lists 13.09 miles in North Carolina; that is a separate and unconnected road of the same number
value.zh: 纽约州内 333.65 英里。路线名录的 I-87 条目另列北卡罗来纳州 13.09 英里，那是一条同编号但彼此无关、互不相连的道路

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: The Thruway Authority and the state transportation department publish counts by segment and by toll gantry. Volumes on the Bronx and Westchester sections are not comparable to those inside the Adirondack Park, and no route-wide figure is issued.
why.zh: 收费高速管理局与州交通部按路段及收费门架发布交通量。布朗克斯与威彻斯特路段的数值与阿迪朗达克公园内部无从比较，亦未发布全线数字。

value.en: About three miles long, eight towers each 419 feet tall, eight general traffic lanes on twin spans, with a 1.5 percent grade against 3 percent on the bridge it replaced
value.zh: 全长约三英里，八座桥塔各高 419 英尺，两幅桥面共设八条常规行车道，纵坡 1.5%，而其所替代的旧桥为 3%

conditionFigures.source: New York State Thruway Authority, Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge design documentation

value.en: 3.1 miles long, opened 15 December 1955 as the longest bridge in New York; the toll was 50 cents
value.zh: 全长 3.1 英里，1955 年 12 月 15 日通车，为当时纽约州最长的桥梁；通行费 50 美分

conditionFigures.source: New York State Thruway Authority, 'History of the NYS Thruway'

timeline.en: The original Tappan Zee Bridge opens, virtually completing the Thruway mainline from Buffalo to the Bronx.
timeline.zh: 原塔潘齐大桥通车，收费高速自布法罗至布朗克斯的主线几近贯通。

timeline.en: I-87 is assigned, and construction of the Adirondack Northway begins at Albany.
timeline.zh: I-87 定名，阿迪朗达克北路自奥尔巴尼开工。

timeline.en: The last 30 miles of the Northway open on 31 August, linking New York City to Montreal by limited-access highway.
timeline.zh: 8 月 31 日，北路最后 30 英里通车，纽约市与蒙特利尔之间形成全封闭公路通道。

timeline.en: I-87 is realigned onto the Thruway between Westchester County and Newburgh, abandoning the planned east-bank route.
timeline.zh: I-87 在威彻斯特县至纽堡之间改走收费高速，放弃原定的东岸线位。

timeline.en: The Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge opens fully, replacing the 1955 Tappan Zee crossing.
timeline.zh: 马里奥·M·科莫州长大桥全面通车，取代 1955 年的塔潘齐大桥。
